name: Multi-feature Radiance Baking Neural Network
aliases: Multi-feature Radiance Baking Neural Network (MRPNN variant)
definition: A neural network method for instant volumetric rendering that extracts multi-scale features (base, transmittance, view, geometry, albedo) and fuses them via hierarchical residual blocks to predict radiance, using towards-light sampling for base and transmittance features.
summary: Multi-feature Radiance Baking Neural Network is a neural volumetric rendering method that achieves real-time performance by reformulating scattering into a diagonal scaling operator, eliminating low-density assumptions and supporting spatially varying albedo.
